questions.question: Explain why H₂O has a higher boiling point than H₂S despite similar molecular mass

points.text: H₂O has H-bonding (O is highly electronegative, lone pairs); H₂S has only dipole-dipole and London forces. H-bonding is much stronger -> more energy to separate molecules -> higher BP
